releaseNotes:
🎬 Instagram Reels & Posts Saved + Direct Deep Links (v1.3.0):
• 🎬 Cover Photos & Previews: Instagram Reel and Post cover images/thumbnails are now reliably captured and displayed directly inside your chat bubbles.
• 🔗 Direct Reel Launching: Fixed deep link routing so tapping 'WATCH REEL' or 'VIEW POST' opens the exact Reel or creator's reels feed, never dumping you onto the generic Instagram home feed.
• 💬 Direct DM Link: Tapping 'OPEN IN DM' takes you straight to the conversation in Instagram where the shared reel is waiting.
• 🛡️ Contact Integrity: Reel cover images will no longer overwrite contacts' personal profile avatars.
